purpose: Illustrative unsent input examples, not execution evidence
reference: User-provided full composer and toolbar screenshots; preserve GPT-6 Astra and toolbar

prompts.en: Use case: text-localization. Produce one localized high-resolution README input-example illustration by faithfully recreating the FULL attached coding-agent message composer screenshot. Reference 1 is the complete composer; reference 2 is the essential bottom toolbar crop. Preserve ALL bottom-toolbar elements, original relative positions, appearance and spacing: white plus lower left, orange shield-outline icon with exclamation mark, orange permission text "Full access", on lower right exact model name "GPT-6 Astra", gray reasoning setting "Medium", small gray downward chevron, blue circular send button with a white upward arrow. NEVER replace the model name with generic Coding Agent; NEVER omit the permission controls or reasoning label. Main input text must be precisely "neo Add user management, analytics, and operations dashboards to this project's backlog.", in large clear off-white sans-serif with correct en glyphs. Keep neo as plain lowercase text prefix, not a badge. Charcoal rounded composer on nearly black background, subtle one-pixel border; preserve compact reference appearance, no glossy textures, no gradients beyond subtle existing shading. Wide banner about 3:1, composer occupies most canvas width with modest dark margins; no huge empty padding. Main message at top, can wrap to two lines if needed without truncation; bottom controls visible on separate row. No responses, success badges, extra headings, watermark, browser chrome or task results. This is an unsent input illustration. Model name must stay EXACTLY "GPT-6 Astra" across languages. Only message and permission/reasoning labels are localized. Deliver one image.
